verdicts.label: 1A
verdicts.note: Verified: the Q3'26 6000 GSM count is 57,557 (E-utilities). The arithmetic matches F577 (X = 1,647 / 11,513 / 24,114). The human+mouse absolute series is new, since F528 covered human only. Q3'26 is lifted by the human jump (36,312) while mouse is volatile (F552). Because of D052's ~2-year deposit lag, this mostly reflects 2024–25 sequencing and says little about the 2027 clinical tail. Keep it weak.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: The denominators check: 53,471+402, 65,343+2,680, 81,671+3,808. The rival share is understated because it excludes DNBSEQ-G400/G99 and other AVITI or Ultima GPLs. The DNBSEQ part is likely China-linked. Most of the share gain came in 2024→25 (+3.2 pts) and only +0.5 pts in 2025→26, so the rise is slowing in GEO.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: The arithmetic checks (1,494/834 = +79%; 1.23% → 1.75%). Read it as an AVITI-led gain derived by subtraction. AVITI+UG captured only ~4% of the y/y increase in GEO HT samples (+660 vs Illumina +16,328), so it is compounding but not yet taking much of the increment.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: 187/336,951 = 0.055%, which checks. The caveat stands: Ultima's scale users (Broad, population and atlas projects) deposit in SRA/dbGaP or controlled access, and F611 could not resolve Ultima in SRA either. Absence from GEO is weak evidence of absence.

verdicts.label: 1A
verdicts.note: This duplicates D052, which already establishes that the GEO X share lags Illumina's reported research X Gb share by about two years and cannot size the tail. No new data.

verdicts.label: 1A
verdicts.note: Verified: Q3'25 = 410,548. These are text-match counts of SRA run accessions (per sample, not instrument runs) by public release date. They include embargo releases of older data and are sensitive to single mega-BioProjects. The 6000 count stops shrinking while total public runs grow ~24% (F611), so the 6000's share still falls. Research and public data only, not the clinical tail.

verdicts.label: 1A
verdicts.note: Verified: Q3'26 X = 152,084, share 27.2%. The direction is fine (+14 pts y/y, +7 q/q). The inference is wrong: a 73% public 6000 run share does not mean most of the mix shift is ahead, because Illumina reports 83% of HT Gb on the X (92% research) and D052 shows a ~2-year lag. It cannot support the '~5 points in 2027' level claim. Q4'25 → Q1'26 the share fell (22.3% → 19.7%), so the series is noisy.

verdicts.label: 2A
verdicts.note: Verified in 10-Q Note 3: $15,512K vs $11,724K (+32.3%). Correction: Twist is a synthetic-DNA and NGS target-enrichment reagent company, not a 'software-and-reagent supplier.' It is a demand read on academic labs, not a price read. Partly offset by F599.

verdicts.label: 2A
verdicts.note: Verified: 9M $40,545K vs $36,589K. H1 is $25,033K vs $24,865K (+0.7%). The 9M figure is +10.8% including the rebound quarter, so the rebound is concentrated in one quarter. The 'promotions' point is from a partly garbled transcript, so treat it as soft.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: Verified: Q3'24 AVITI = 966. Correction: AVITI as a share of 6000 runs in Q3'24 was 966/551,041 = 0.18%, not 1.7%. The path is 0.18% → 1.21% → 2.65%, which is steeper than stated. Note the 6000 denominator here (408,823, [Instrument] field) differs slightly from F595's text-match 407,958.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: Verified: Q3'26 = 35,144. Relabeled 2B because public SRA deposits are research data, not large clinical accounts. The jump from 15.7K to 35.1K in two quarters could be a few large BioProjects, and DNBSEQ submitters are China-linked. Also, mainland China largely deposits to CNCB-GSA, so SRA understates and noises MGI. The price-competitor read is indirect.

verdicts.label: 2B
verdicts.note: The arithmetic checks (2.30% / 3.64% / 7.58%). Relabeled 2B because the data is research and public. About 76% of the Q3'26 rival count is DNBSEQ-T7 (35,144/45,982), so the caveats in F610 apply. This partly overlaps F609/F610 as a combination. Counts are runs, not Gb.

derived.label: 2B
derived.claim: Rival platforms (AVITI plus DNBSEQ-T7) took about 23% of the year-on-year growth in new-platform public SRA runs in Q3'26, up from about 9% in Q3'25, so challengers are capturing a rising share of incremental research sequencing.
derived.detail: Q3'25 vs Q3'24: X runs grew by 43,974 (16,351 → 60,325) and AVITI+T7 by 4,484 (13,360 → 17,844), so rivals took 4,484/48,458 = 9.3% of the increment. Q3'26 vs Q3'25: X grew by 91,759 (→ 152,084) and rivals by 28,138 (→ 45,982), giving 28,138/119,897 = 23.5%. Ex-T7 (AVITI only), the share rises from 4,005/47,979 = 8.3% to 5,867/97,626 = 6.0%. The acceleration is therefore driven by DNBSEQ-T7 (likely China-linked), not Element. Counts are run accessions by release date, not Gb.
derived.why_new: Measures rival capture of incremental runs rather than share of the stock, and shows the AVITI-only capture is falling.

derived.label: 2B
derived.claim: In GEO, rivals' share of the year-on-year increase in HT samples fell from about 16% to about 6.5%, which contradicts SRA's accelerating rival capture. The rival-momentum signal depends on the dataset chosen.
derived.detail: GEO human+mouse: Illumina 6000+X samples grew by 11,872 (53,471 → 65,343) in Q3'25 and by 16,328 (→ 81,671) in Q3'26. Rival GSMs grew by 2,278 (402 → 2,680) and then by 1,128 (→ 3,808). Rival capture of the increment was 2,278/14,150 = 16.1% and then 1,128/17,456 = 6.5%; AVITI+UG alone captured ~3.9% in Q3'26 (660/16,988). The two public datasets disagree on direction, so neither is strong evidence of accelerating research share loss.
derived.url: https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gds&term=(GPL34295[ACCN] OR GPL34475[ACCN] OR GPL34762[ACCN] OR GPL36595[ACCN] OR GPL29480[ACCN] OR GPL28330[ACCN]) AND gsm[ETYP] AND 2026/07/01:2026/09/30[PDAT]&retmax=0
derived.why_new: Cross-checks the GEO and SRA rival series against each other and finds they conflict, which no item states.

derived.label: 2A
derived.claim: Public research sequencing activity rebounded in the latest year: five-platform SRA run releases rose about 24% y/y in Q3'26 after falling about 16% in Q3'25.
derived.detail: 6000+X+AVITI+T7 runs were 581,731 (Q3'24), 489,660 (Q3'25) and 606,789 (Q3'26), which is −15.8% and then +23.9%. GEO HT samples rose +22% and then +25%. Together with Twist's academic revenue (+32% in the June 2026 quarter), this points to research volume recovering rather than flat. That cuts against a 'volume flat' research thesis, although the runs are publication-lagged and are not Gb or dollars.
derived.why_new: Total public run growth and the triangulation with Twist are not stated in any item.
